items.title: 20.2.1 Tools used in Recombinant DNA Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the tools of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Gene of interest woh gene hai jis par kaam karna hai. Ise teen tareeqon se hasil kiya ja sakta hai.

items: Laboratory mein polymerases aur ligases jaise enzymes se seedha banana.
Is ke mRNA se reverse transcription ke zariye, enzyme reverse transcriptase se, banana.
Restriction endonucleases se chromosome se kaat kar nikalna.

blocks.text: Yeh enzymes, 'molecular qainchiyan', DNA mein khaas nucleotide silsile kaat'te hain. Har qisam apna silsila, restriction site ya recognition region, pehchanti, wahan jurti aur us ke andar khaas jagah se DNA kaat'ti hai. Restriction sites chaar se aath nucleotides ke palindromic silsile hain: aik sire ke nucleotides doosre sire ke complementary hote hain, is liye dono strands mukhalif simton mein aik hi silsila parhte hain. Enzyme dono strands kaat'ta hai aur dono tukron par chand nucleotides lambe single-stranded sire chhorta hai jo aik doosre ke complementary hain, yaani sticky ends.

blocks.alt: Double-stranded DNA ACGGAATTCTGC ke neeche TGCCTTAAGACG, site GAATTC dabbe mein. Surkh dashed lakeer seedhi nahi balke seerhi (staggered) kaat dikhati hai, oopar ke strand par G ke baad aur neeche wale par G se pehle. Neeche do tukre, har aik ka single-stranded sticky end (AATT aur TTAA) hare dabbe mein.
blocks.caption: Restriction endonuclease sticky ends banata hua (Figure 20.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Restriction endonucleases, yaani 'molecular qainchiyan', har aik aik khaas nucleotide silsila, restriction site, pehchanti hain jo chaar se aath nucleotides ka hota hai. Yeh sites palindromic hain: dono strands mukhalif simton mein aik hi silsila parhte hain. Enzyme site se jur kar dono strands ko khaas jagah, aksar seerhi shakal mein, kaat'ta hai aur dono tukron par chhote single-stranded sire chhorta hai jo aik doosre ke complementary hain (sticky ends). Is liye aik hi enzyme se kate do DNA tukre jorre ja sakte hain. Dikhayi gayi misaal enzyme EcoRI ki site hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Restriction endonucleases is liye qeemti hain ke aik hi restriction endonuclease se bane koi bhi do DNA tukre aapas mein jorre ja sakte hain.

Vectors, yaani molecular carriers, gene of interest ko host cells mein le jate hain: gene vector se jorra jata hai jo recombinant DNA ban jata hai, aur rDNA host cells mein dala jata hai. Bacteria ke plasmids sab se zyada use hote hain.

items: Bacteriophages, jaise phage lambda aur bacteriophage P1.
Cosmids: aise plasmids jin mein bacteriophage DNA ka chhota hissa, cos sequence, hota hai.
P1 artificial chromosomes, P1 vectors aur BACs dono ki khasiyaton wale.
Janwaron ke viruses, jaise insani zukaam ka virus, bandar aur insani cells mein genes le jane ke liye.

blocks.text: DNA ligase do DNA tukre jorta hai, is liye ise molecular gond kehte hain: yeh do saath wale nucleotides ke darmiyan phosphodiester rabt banata hai.

Expression system aisa munasib jandar hai jo rDNA ka mezbaan ban kar gene of interest zahir kar sake; is ka intikhab use kiye gaye vector par munhasir hai. Bacterial cells behtareen hain kyunke un ki nasl ka waqt chhota aur genetic nizam saada hai.

blocks.prompt: Gene aur plasmid ko aik hi restriction enzyme se kyun kaatna zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Taa ke dono par mutabiq (complementary) sticky ends hon jo jur sakein aur phir DNA ligase unhein pakka kare.

items: Gene of interest: banaya, mRNA se reverse transcribe, ya chromosome se kaata.
Restriction enzymes palindromic sites kaat kar sticky ends chhorte.
Vectors (zyada tar plasmids) genes le jate; ligase jorta; bacteria zahir karte.
